questions.question: Describe how melody are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary.

points.text: A detailed description using precise musical vocabulary (e.g. specific terms from the AQA elements list), referencing a named piece with accurate observations about how the elements are used and their effect.

questions.question: Compare how two different pieces use melody. Explain the effect in each case.

points.text: A comparison of two pieces identifying similarities and differences in how melody are used, explaining the different effects created in each musical context, using comparative language.

questions.question: How could you use melody in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.

points.text: A practical application showing understanding of how melody can be manipulated in composition or performance, with specific examples of choices made and their intended effect.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: identify specific melodic types (conjunct, disjunct, triadic); note ornamentation types by name; explain the EFFECT of melodic choices on the listener; use staff notation references where relevant; compare melodic features across different sections of the piece. Mark scheme: AO3 (analyse and evaluate) + AO4 (knowledge and understanding) = total marks for listening; AO1 (perform) + AO2 (compose) for coursework components
